title: Cauldron
wikitext:
'''The Cauldron''' is an enormous excavation site in the center of the [[Searing Gorge]]. It was fortified some time after [[Ragnaros]] was summoned by the [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron dwarves]]. It is rimmed by the giant excavation machines of the [[Dark Iron clan]]. In the burning depths of the Cauldron, [[Fire elemental|fire]] and [[magma elemental]]s traverse the fiery crevices.

Many [[Slave Worker]]s captured by the Dark Irons toil away endlessly inside the Cauldron. Driven mad by their masters, the grueling work, and the constant oppressive heat, they will attack anyone interfering with their work in the Cauldron — even potential liberators.

==Notes and trivia==
*This area is referenced in one of the [[human]] male's [[jokes]], as a parallel to {{wp|Mount Doom}} in ''{{wp|The Lord of the Rings}}'' trilogy. However, in the joke he will say that the Cauldron is in the [[Burning Steppes]] rather than the Searing Gorge.
